prompt: In an anime style busy restaurant kitchen, a chef with a tall white hat stands center holding a sizzling pan. To the left, a waiter in a blue apron points urgently at a steaming pot on the stove. Next to the waiter, a small gray cat sits calmly on a wooden crate, observing the chaos. On the right, a dishwasher with wet sleeves hands a clean plate to a manager in a sharp suit who looks at the time on his wrist. There is no fire visible in the scene. The chef flips food in the pan while the waiter gestures toward the heat. The manager accepts the plate from the dishwasher with a nod. The cat remains still on its perch. The kitchen is filled with hanging utensils and stacked bowls, but the focus remains on these five distinct figures engaged in their specific tasks amidst the culinary rush.
